'''Bertil Gustafsson''' (born 1939) is a [[Swedes|Swedish]] applied mathematician and [[Numerical analysis|numerical analyst]]. He is currently a Professor emeritus in the Department of Information Technology at [[Uppsala University]], [[Sweden]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.it.uu.se/katalog/bertil|title=Bertil Gustafsson|accessdate=1 May 2010}}</ref> Gustafsson is known for his work in [[Numerical analysis|numerical methods]] for time-dependent [[partial differential equation]]s and its applications in [[fluid dynamics]]. He is the G in GKS (Gustafsson–[[Heinz-Otto Kreiss|Kreiss]]–Sundstrom) theory for initial-boundary value problems which discusses the stability criterion for numerical approximations of initial–boundary value problems.<ref>{{cite book|last=Ryaben'kii|first=Victor S.|author2=Semyon V. Tsynkov|title=A theoretical introduction to numerical analysis|publisher=Chapman & Hall/CRC|year=2007|isbn=9781584886075|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=V8gWP031-hEC&q=%22GKS+theory%22+for+initial-boundary+value+problems&pg=PA410}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|last=Ascher|first=Uri M.|title=Numerical methods for evolutionary differential equations |publisher=[[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics|SIAM]]|year=2008|isbn=9780898718911|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=_bodx5uHkuYC&q=%22GKS+theory%22+for+initial-boundary+value+problems&pg=PA268}}</ref> Gustafsson has also authored a couple of books on the topic numerical methods applied to PDE.

==Education and career==
Gustafsson attended senior high school in [[Norrköping]], a city in Sweden. In 1962, he joined Uppsala University, where there was a tradition of prominent mathematicians, including [[Arne Beurling]] and [[Lennart Carleson]].<ref name="siam">{{cite web|url=http://history.siam.org/pdfs2/gustafsson_final.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240420191911/https://history.siam.org/pdfs2/gustafsson_final.pdf|url-status=dead|archive-date=April 20, 2024|title=An interview with Bertil Gustafsson|publisher=[[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics|SIAM]]|accessdate=1 May 2010}}</ref> At Uppsala, Gustafsson developed a strong preference for applied mathematics and when he was in his second year, [[Heinz-Otto Kreiss]] joined Uppsala University. It was Kreiss who introduced young Gustafsson to [[numerical analysis]], and the then new field of [[computing]]. In 1971, Gustafsson received his Ph.D. degree under the supervision of Kreiss. His dissertation was on difference methods for [[Hyperbolic partial differential equation|hyperbolic equations]]. Gustafsson has continued to pursue numerical methods in differential equations for most of his career, and much of his early work consisted of applying his theoretical developments to practical problems. These included [[Weather forecasting|weather prediction]], both in Sweden and at the [[National Center for Atmospheric Research]] based in [[Boulder, Colorado]].<ref name="siam" />

In 2002, he was elected a member of the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]].

==Books==
*High Order Difference Methods for Time Dependent PDE, Springer-Verlag (2008). {{ISBN|3-540-74992-6}}
*Time Dependent Problems and Difference Methods, with [[Heinz-Otto Kreiss]] and [[Joseph Oliger]], John Wiley (1995).
